preconditions.description: The number of operations is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each operation type is between 1 and 3, inclusive.
The integer x_i for operation type 1 is between -1000 and 1000, inclusive.
The integer k_i for operation type 2 is between -1000 and 1000, inclusive.
The integer a_i for operation type 1 is between 1 and the current size of the sequence, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: There will always be at least one element in the sequence
preconditions.description: The sequence will never be empty during any operation.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each operation.

postconditions.expression: Each line contains the average of the numbers in the sequence after the corresponding operation
postconditions.description: The output for each operation is the average of the numbers in the sequence after that operation.

postconditions.expression: The absolute or relative error does not exceed 10^{-6}
postconditions.description: The output's average is within 10^{-6} of the true average, either absolutely or relative to the true average.
